## Welcome to MSDA Bootcamp

Our bootcamp covers three areas of knowledge essential for data analytics in social sciences
    
1. Mathematical foundations for data analytics (Calculus and Linear Algebra)

2. R (and R Studio) for data visualization and data wrangling

3. Probability and Statistics

## Schedule

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# Define the schedule data

schedule <- tibble(
  Date = c(
    "2026-08-25",
    "2026-08-25",
    "2026-08-26",
    "2026-08-26",
    "2026-08-27",
    "2026-08-27"
  ),
  Time = c(
    "10:00 - 13:00",
    "14:00 - 17:00",
    "10:00 - 13:00",
    "14:00 - 17:00",
    "10:00 - 13:00",
    "14:00 - 17:00"
  ),
  Topic = c(
    "Overview and Review of Calculus",
    "Review of Linear Algebra",
    "Introduction to R (and RStudio)",
    "Data Visualization with ggplot2",
    "Data Wrangling with tidyverse",
    "Elements of Probability and Statistics"
  )
)

# Convert Date to a more readable format
schedule <- schedule %>%
  mutate(Date = format(as.Date(Date), "%B %d, %Y"))

# Create a basic HTML table
kable(
  schedule,
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Date", "Time", "Topic"),
  align = "l"
) %>% 
kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#007BFF") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "15em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "15em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "30em")

```
